summary: No material integrity blocker found in the audited formal runs. Real artifacts and independent recomputation support empirical action imitation and a single-object tight-budget exposure gain, not robust visual active decision making or defect diagnosis.
reviewer_model: Codex GPT-6 family; exact provider revision not available to reviewer
trace_note: Reviewer performed direct read-only tool calls and independent inline deterministic checks in this agent session. Task authorization restricts writes to these two audit reports; parent session retains tool trace.

gt_provenance.details: Existing Train/Validation PartNet data and injected corruption labels, not model-generated answers. Reconstructed 496/121 exact-prefix groups and all empirical frequencies. All 672 Active requests contain only the exact acquired prefix; all 849 final requests contain the completed observed history. Dataset-private candidate construction and post-hoc scoring remain outside model transport. Frozen Test was not opened by this audit.

score_normalization.details: Assistant-token mean CE is probability-weighted within each complete group; groups have equal weight. No prediction-based denominator. Exposure uses 29 injected defects, case evidence uses 19 nonclean cases, diagnosis uses all 28 cases including invalid outputs. Whole-action empirical entropy is not the token-normalized CE lower bound.

result_existence.details: All 336 formal episodes, 672 Active replies, 849 final replies, 1680 PNGs, 1488 updates, 1234 learning rows and adapter exist. Independent recount matches all report cells and per-object deltas. Adapter hash matches training and actual SFT-server ready record. Remaining limitation: old base-server ready logs only host/port and cannot independently attest exact historical base-weight/environment/code bytes.

dead_code.details: Scoring, grouping, teacher loss, model generation, post-hoc exposure and aggregation are reached by the recorded pipeline. Reconstructed all 168 Fixed/Random trajectories with unchanged original witness planner. EngineeringModel is selected only by engineering_smoke; formal configs set false and all formal model calls identify Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct.

scope.details: One training seed, seven independent Validation objects and 28 reused cases, three correlated budgets. K2/K4 gains over Fixed arise entirely from PM_1280; K6 loses three exposed defects relative to Fixed. Every method/budget has 0/19 exact diagnoses on defective cases. No image ablation or causal evidence of semantic image-dependent policy learning. Existing repaired protocol and original-prompt learning evaluation must remain distinct.

eval_type.details: Actual Qwen inference and real Chromium executions on dataset-provided PartNet assets with dataset-injected corruption labels. Closed-loop exposure is a counterfactual pixel proxy; action-learning agreement is empirical privileged-teacher imitation. Neither is human evaluation or demonstrated real-world semantic diagnosis.

claims.claim: The single requested Action-only LoRA training ran and fitted the empirical action supervision.
claims.qualification: Actual updates, saved nonzero adapter, reload hash, lower teacher-forced NLL and generated action matching exist. This establishes empirical imitation only.

claims.claim: Action SFT obtains more pixel-exposed defects than Fixed at K2 and K4.
claims.qualification: 17 vs 15 and 19 vs 16 of 29; all positive object-level deltas are PM_1280. Effective independent n=7.

claims.claim: Action SFT is reliably better than Fixed or learned a robust visual active policy.
claims.qualification: K6 exposure is 22 vs 25; one seed, no image ablation, budget shift and privileged-teacher frequency targets.

claims.claim: Higher aggregate final accuracy demonstrates restored defect diagnosis.
claims.qualification: Every policy/budget has 0/19 defective-case exact diagnoses; all correct diagnoses are clean cases.

claims.claim: Final diagnosis consistently disables the Action adapter and uses the same public protocol.
claims.qualification: Call graph and all recorded prompts support this; SFT reload has its SHA, while old base-service ready lacks runtime weight/environment/code attestation.

limitations: Read-only audit did not rerun GPU training/inference or Chromium counterfactual rendering. NLL arithmetic and call path were checked, not re-executed on GPU; exposure thresholds were recomputed from saved raw numeric signals, while counterfactual PNGs were not archived for an independent pixel calculation.
Old base-server ready record lacks runtime base weight/environment/code SHA. Current reproduction scripts cannot retroactively establish those historical bytes.
Source-code hashes in run_config do not cover every transitive dependency; audit hashes pin the inspected current versions, not prove historical versions of all dependencies.
No human semantic review, image ablation, repeated training seeds, new datasets or frozen Test were used.
action_items: Retain the REPORT qualifiers: n=7, PM_1280-only tight-budget gain, K6 below Fixed, pixel proxy and defective-case 0/19.
Keep original-prompt prefix learning and acquisition-only closed-loop results distinct; preserve and exclude both stopped legacy runs.

For a future separately authorized run, record runtime weight/config/code/environment hashes on every server and preserve counterfactual scoring PNGs. Do not rerun or alter this completed experiment solely to improve its ranking.
